programs.name: Hume Home Energy Upgrades
programs.operator: Hume City Council / Yarra Energy Foundation
programs.statusNote: Registrations are paused after delivery partner Yarra Energy Foundation entered voluntary administration (ASIC notice 10 Nov 2026). Only insulation and draught-proofing registrations lodged before 19 Oct 2026 continue.

programs.name: Hume Household Energy Officer (Energy Bill Support)
programs.statusNote: Hume City Council's Household Energy Officer provides resident and community-group guidance on Victorian energy concessions, Utility Relief Grants, and retailer payment plans.

programs.name: Melton Living Green Power-Mate Meter Loans
programs.statusNote: Melton City Council lends Power-Mate Lite plug-in energy meters so residents can measure appliance electricity use at home before choosing upgrades.

programs.name: Darebin Energy Upgrades
programs.operator: City of Darebin / Yarra Energy Foundation
programs.statusNote: Program registrations are paused after delivery partner Yarra Energy Foundation entered voluntary administration (ASIC notice 10 Nov 2026).

programs.name: Macedon Ranges Heat Pump Hot Water Bulk Buy
programs.statusNote: Closed to new enquiries on 31 Oct 2026; installations for existing bookings end 30 Nov 2026.

programs.name: Council Home Energy Program
programs.statusNote: Participating-council advisory and vetted-supplier program across 12 metropolitan Melbourne councils.

programs.name: City of Boroondara Solar Savers Program
programs.statusNote: Boroondara residents can access a free home energy assessment and a one-off council discount on eligible upgrades until 31 Dec 2026 or until program funds are exhausted.

programs.name: City of Whittlesea Home Energy Program
programs.statusNote: Council-supported home energy advice and upgrade subsidies run until June 2027 or until funding is exhausted.

programs.name: Wyndham Energy Smart Homes & Home Energy in Your Language
programs.statusNote: Electrification workshop recordings, borrowable library efficiency kits in Wyndham, and interpreted Home Energy in Your Language webinars across six western councils.

programs.name: City of Casey DIY Draught-Proofing Rebate
programs.statusNote: Council rebate for eligible DIY draught-proofing products purchased and installed by City of Casey residents (one claim per household).

programs.name: SEC Heat Pump Hot Water Pilot (Maroondah & Yarra Ranges)
programs.statusNote: State-owned SEC heat pump hot water one-stop-shop pilot open to residents in Maroondah and the Yarra Ranges alongside Ballan and Latrobe City.

programs.name: SEC Installer Network (Merri-bek & Casey)
programs.statusNote: State-owned SEC installer network open to households in Merri-bek and Casey alongside Ballarat ahead of broader 2026 statewide rollout.

programs.name: Electric Homes Program 2026–27
programs.statusNote: Community-council bulk-buy and advice program across Greater Geelong, Surf Coast, Golden Plains, Colac Otway and Queenscliffe (expressions of interest opened 5 Oct 2026).

programs.name: Goulburn Murray Solar Savers
programs.statusNote: Vetted-provider program for solar, batteries, heat pump hot water, split systems, insulation, draught proofing and home energy assessments across seven GMCA councils (Feb 2026 notice).

programs.name: Macedon Ranges Sustainable Home Kits & Climate Action Resources
programs.statusNote: Council resources include library Sustainable Home Kit loans, Cool Changes community climate plans across seven town groups, and Empower Your Home webinars (no council cash rebate).

programs.name: SEC Heat Pump Hot Water Pilot (Latrobe City)
programs.statusNote: State-owned SEC one-stop-shop pilot covering Morwell, Moe, Newborough, Traralgon, and Churchill with product comparisons and quotes from SEC-endorsed installers.

programs.name: Mildura Library Home Energy Efficiency Toolkit
programs.statusNote: Mildura Rural City Council lends Home Energy Efficiency Toolkits (thermal camera, PowerMate Lite energy meter, thermometer, and water flow cup) through Mildura Library.
